lines.1: 「...So. As you can see, the boys are butlers and the girls are maids.」
lines.2: 「At the Sports and Martial Arts Festival, we'll use these outfits to welcome visitors at the school gate.」
lines.3: 「Mainly we'll hand out pamphlets, but there's plenty else to do: directions to the restrooms, explaining events, and so on.」
lines.4: 「When your event is coming up, tag someone else in. Basically, we'll rotate shifts.」
lines.6: 「Still easier than serving food like the cooking club does.」
lines.8: 「Can't we just smile and hand them over normally?」
lines.9: 「Don't run your mouth like you know what you're talking about, amateur!」
lines.14: 「Here is your pamphlet for the Sports and Martial Arts Festival. Please take your time and enjoy yourselves.」
lines.19: 「Now you understand why the drama club gets this job, right?」
lines.20: 「Yeah. Seriously, the second one was amazing. Made my heart skip a beat.」
lines.21: 「I was only demonstrating! It's not like I did it for you.」
lines.23: 「Anyone left over can go with me...」
lines.27: 「I'm an outsider here, so I ended up all alone.」
lines.29: I had a bad feeling about this.
lines.30: In the end, we spent the entire morning practicing our performance.
lines.33: 「...Didn't you say you ate the same thing for breakfast?」
lines.34: I don't get it. Between her and Otome's rice balls, why do they only ever eat the same thing?
lines.36: The drama club gathered in front of the school gate.
lines.37: This was where we'd be stationed during the festival.
lines.41: 「Apparently, two days before the festival, a delegation made up of all the committee chairs inspects every section.」
lines.43: 「Meaning it has to be spotless by Tuesday, or you won't make it.」
lines.44: 「Besides, we can't work ourselves to the bone the day before the festival and greet guests looking exhausted.」
lines.45: 「Yeah. It'd be rough if you had bags under your eyes...」
lines.46: 「I know all that, and I'm still saying I'll do it myself.」
lines.48: The club members were worried about their president.
lines.50: 「If I don't get it cleaned properly--if it fails inspection--I'll take responsibility and step down as president.」
lines.52: 「That's how serious I am, so don't worry.」
lines.53: 「Enough about that. Let's do practical drills so we can guide visitors efficiently.」
lines.55: 「Suppose someone asks you for directions right when your event is about to start. Or suddenly asks you to pose for a photo.」
lines.56: 「Calling it customer service may be a bit much, but we've had all kinds of trouble in past years.」
lines.57: 「If we review how to handle it beforehand, we can avoid any mistakes.」
lines.59: She really was good at this stuff.
lines.60: 「We'll spend the rest of the afternoon going over all of it.」
lines.61: 「Then we'll change clothes and go help out on the field.」
lines.63: I was in the go-home club last year, so I'd never really felt it.
lines.64: With everyone working this hard, no wonder the Sports and Martial Arts Festival gets so lively.
lines.65: In the end, we worked on the field until late again.
lines.66: Partway through, the cooking club brought us some food.
lines.67: That feeling of everyone pulling together wasn't half bad.
lines.68: It got dark around us, and students started heading home.
lines.70: 「You'd better show up tomorrow too. No running away.」
lines.71: 「...That's a hell of a way to put it.」
lines.72: 「Hmph. After the way you've acted so far, it's only fair.」
lines.73: 「I'm going to clean the gate a little before I go home.」
lines.75: I'd been so busy I forgot.
